source_context: Derived from the latest K1m6a/Coinwise post-capitulation sequence already stored in the live casebook.

decision_tree.name: A_BULLISH_RECLAIM
conditions: Price reclaims ~77.46k dVAL and holds/retests above it.
CVD stays stable/up or at least stops making new lows.
OI may rise, but rising OI must continue to produce higher price rather than stall below value.
decision_tree.interpretation: Post-capitulation recovery is converting from a reflex bounce into structural repair.
staging: First small tranche only after dVAL acceptance.
Higher-quality add only after dPOC ~78.145k reclaim/hold.
decision_tree.invalidation: Back below dVAL with CVD rolling over and OI elevated/rising.

decision_tree.name: B_FAILED_RECLAIM_SHORT
conditions: Price bounces into ~77.4-77.7k / dVAL but cannot accept above.
A lower high or clear rejection forms.
CVD stops recovering or turns down.
OI stays elevated or rises while price weakens.
decision_tree.interpretation: Buyer effort and re-leveraging failed to repair broken value; fresh leverage is vulnerable below resistance.
decision_tree.preferred_entry_logic: Short the failed repair/retest, not the liquidation low.
decision_tree.invalidation: Acceptance above dVAL and especially dPOC with positive price response.

decision_tree.name: C_BEARISH_CONTINUATION_BREAKDOWN
conditions: Price loses the post-flush local support / returns through ~77.0k toward ~76.75k.
OI turns UP or remains elevated instead of collapsing with price.
decision_tree.interpretation: Transition from forced deleveraging into bearish leverage expansion after old longs have already been cleaned.
decision_tree.warning: If OI is collapsing violently again, avoid chasing the low; that is another liquidation leg rather than clean fresh short build.
decision_tree.invalidation: Rapid reclaim of the lost local support with CVD stabilization.

decision_tree.name: D_RANGE_ABSORPTION
conditions: Price stays roughly between the capitulation area and dVAL.
CVD oscillates without decisive new lows/highs.
OI rebuilds but price remains trapped.
decision_tree.interpretation: Leverage is rebuilding inside balance; direction is not yet resolved.
decision_tree.confirmation_needed: Trade only the eventual dVAL reclaim/acceptance or failed-reclaim rejection with flow confirmation.

meta_rule: After capitulation, location and price-efficiency dominate the raw Price/CVD/OI matrix. Price UP + CVD UP + OI UP below broken value is only an early recovery candidate; if buyer effort and OI rebuild cannot reclaim value, the same data can become fuel for a failed-reclaim short.
execution_note: All listed levels are reference-chart values. Convert to the actual execution venue using current basis before placing orders.
